newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel court orders police who beat Arabs to jail.
newsitem.headline: Israel court orders police who beat Arabs to jail.

text.p: An Israeli court on Thursday sentenced two paramilitary policemen filmed brutalising Palestinians to eight months in jail, Israel radio said.

"The two policemen degraded the border police uniform and must receive a punishment that will deter others," the radio quoted the judge as saying. The men were sentenced to eight months in prison and an another 12 months of suspended jail time.
Border policemen Tsahi Shamaya, 19, and David Ben Abu, 20, were filmed by an amateur cameraman last October assaulting six Palestinians caught in Jerusalem without entry permits.
The videotape, showing the two policemen kicking some of the Palestinians in the head, kneeing another in the stomach and forcing others to do push-ups, was broadcast across the world.
Shamaya and Ben Abu were charged with aggravated assault and abuse of authority.
Witnesses said family members erupted from their seats in rage after hearing the verdict. One woman was evicted for calling the judge a 'leftist'.
